_note: Every count, probability and date the app uses. Researchers change them here, never in code. Counts per person are cue-carrying cards; each family adds `baselinePerFamily` all-baseline presentations per form. The counts follow research plan v2 (19 Oct 2026, section 1.1), which supersedes v1's; planning values are marked: P1's pilot replaces them (plan v1, 7.4). Change a count here and run `pnpm length` and `pnpm check`.

timing._source: plan-scripts/cap_fit.py, planning values in seconds at the 80th percentile of players, none sourced; P1 replaces them

targets._source: research plan v2, 1.1 and 1.2 (the panel as two games; the firm with two conduct rematch cards)

panel-g1._layout: Plan v2 1.1. Form A then the screening block for FULL players. Low scorers: the honest survey, the note (faking or honest retake, 1:1), form B, the survey again, the recall item. High scorers: Off the Record (M1-H's random subsample takes the statement route; every other high scorer takes neutral privacy items of the same length). R1's partial arms: form A in their arm, then the wrap. No rematch in game 1 (plan v2 1.2).

panel-g2._layout: Plan v2 1.1. Conduct cards (M3's halves), Off the Record (M5's practice, M3's items, module RC for a random share, padded otherwise), the Committee Inbox (24 cards, language per card), the note (a or b, 1:1, unstratified: game 2 has no screening block), form B, the survey once, the recall item.

firm._layout: Plan v2 1.1 and 3: as plan v1, with two conduct rematch cards (S5's consistency guard). S2's Inbox is 42 cards (21 harassment, 21 near-miss), not plan v2's 44: this build counts two things cap_fit_v2.py does not, the Inbox's content-note screen (15 s) and the direct block's four repeat pairs, and at 44 the session is 30.6 minutes. The Inbox gives two cards at a time (PF-18) until it fits.

split._note: PLANNING VALUE. The screening block's fairness score (0 unfair to 1 fair) below which a player is a low scorer. P1 fixes it at its pilot's 30th percentile.

m1h._note: PLANNING VALUE: share of high scorers drawn into M1-H's statement route.

m3._note: PLANNING VALUES (PO-1): the floor quantile q and the permutation counts.

rc._note: PLANNING VALUE: share of Game 2 players who also take module RC.

release._note: DEMO dates. Each deployment's release date is the day after its whole play window closes.
